preconditions.description: Attacker must be the owner of the contract.

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the `UpdateTaxes` function to manipulate the fee structure. Set the `transferTax` parameter to its maximum allowed value of 50. To satisfy the function's requirements, ensure the sum of the other tax parameters (`burnTaxes`, `buybackTaxes`, `devTaxes`, `marketingTaxes`, `liquidityTaxes`, `stakingTaxes`) equals 100. For example, you can set `marketingTaxes` to 100 and all other distribution taxes to 0.
